stock.description: Minsheng Education Group Company Limited, an investment holding entity headquartered in Beijing, People's Republic of China, specializes in delivering a broad spectrum of educational services across the nation. Established in 2005 as a subsidiary of Minsheng Group Company Limited, the company oversees a significant portfolio of educational establishments, including seven higher education institutions, two secondary vocational schools, and one high school. Its comprehensive offerings encompass both conventional and contemporary learning pathways. This includes undergraduate and junior college degree programs, diverse vocational and technical training initiatives, and ongoing professional development for educators. Beyond direct instruction, Minsheng Education provides extensive support services such as educational management and consulting, the development of specialized educational software and technology, and the operation of digital learning platforms, including cloud training and distance education systems. The Group's operations also extend into various ancillary and diversified sectors. These cover university and college logistics, property rental and business management, investment and asset management, project investment, and real estate development. Furthermore, the company offers specialized services such as disease diagnosis and treatment, cultural and artistic exchange programs, advertising, computer animation design, human resource compliance consulting, and intermediary services for students pursuing overseas studies.
